facts.fact: APS reports that Senegal's SENUM SA and Mali's SMTD-SA inaugurated the interconnection of their national fibre-optic backbones at the Kidira-Diboli border bridge on Monday 2026-10-05, described by SENUM's director general as putting the infrastructure into service; no capacity or traffic figure is given.
facts.system: interconnexion des backbones du Senegal et du Mali (SENUM SA - SMTD-SA)
